components.text: Social insurance 2,700 × 12 = 32,400. Special additional (1,500 + 1,500) × 12 = 36,000. Paid 4,240 = salary withholding 2,640 + design fee withholding 1,600

footnote: Example, figures are made up. Basis: STA Order No. 57, Art. 3, STA Announcement No. 61 of 2018, Arts. 6 and 8
notes: Line by line. Income: salary counts in full at 180,000, the design fee at 80%, so 8,000, total 188,000. Deductions: 60,000 basic, social insurance 2,700 times 12 is 32,400, and the two special additional deductions, 1,500 plus 1,500 for 12 months, are 36,000. Total 128,400. Taxable income: 188,000 minus 128,400 is 59,600. That lands in bracket 2: times 10% minus 2,520 gives tax due of 3,440. If you don't trust the quick deduction, do it in pieces: 36,000 at 3% is 1,080, the remaining 23,600 at 10% is 2,360, total 3,440. Already paid: the employer withheld 2,640 over the year and the design job had 1,600 withheld, 4,240 in all. 4,240 minus 3,440: they overpaid by 800 and can claim RMB 800 back. Side note: their take-home pay drops from September, because cumulative taxable income passes 36,000 and moves into the 10% bracket. The employer has not made a mistake.
